# Book of Giants Fragment 11 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 4Q203 frag. 9 (Cave 4) | **Condition:** very fragmentary; destruction narrative partially legible

---

**11:1** [...] Then the holy angels [...] who serve in God's very presence [...]

**11:2** [...] received their orders from the Most High [...]

**11:3** [...] and came down carrying fire [...]

**11:4** [...] from the glorious throne [...]

**11:5** [...] They rained fire down from heaven [...]

**11:6** [...] It consumed [...] every last one of the Nephilim [...]

**11:7** [...] and all the children of the Watchers [...]

**11:8** [...] The earth was purified [...] of their contamination [...]

**11:9** [...] and of all the blood spilled upon it [...]

**11:10** [...] and of every wicked thing [...]

**11:11** [...] The Watchers themselves were bound [...] with chains of darkness [...]

**11:12** [...] deep in the valleys of the earth [...]

**11:13** [...] to wait for the great judgment [...]

**11:14** [...] when they will be dragged to the fiery abyss [...]

**11:15** [...] to eternal punishment and imprisonment [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Fragment 11 (Angels of Punishment). Source: 4Q203 frag. 9. The PNEUMA translation prioritizes readability and natural modern English, rendering the ancient Aramaic in a way accessible to contemporary readers. Imagery is vivified and syntax restructured for impact while remaining faithful to the underlying meaning. Square brackets indicate genuine gaps in the surviving manuscript fragments from Qumran Cave 4.*
